text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: I'm heading to my office with Ines<n>Fujin, when...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yeah... It's been bugging me since<n>this morning.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I've got work today—I hope this<n>doesn't affect my
customer service...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hey-hey, could you pretend to be a<n>customer for a
second?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Welcome! What would you like to<n>eat?
choice_data_list: A super-spicy bowl with extra, extra garlic.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Pfft, ahaha! I'm working at a fast<n>food place today,
not the ramen shop!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Ah! Laughing makes my<n>headache throb even
harder...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin continues to suffer from<n>her headache
for some time.
